# vappcloud_devices (Data Source)

Lists devices in a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vappcloud_devices" "all" {
  project_id = "project_example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only
